spans.s:
mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Much, exceeding; (in this sense it is also an adverb declinable in the neuter gender.)
2 Hard, firm.
3 Able, powerful.
4 Bulky, massive, solid.
5

Strong.
6

Confirmed.
n. (-ढं)
Iron.
E.
दृह to increase, affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Dhaliākāra.
E.
दृढ much or many, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-ण्डः)
A bambu.
E.
दृढ, and काण्ड a stem.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Persevering, determined.
E.
दृढ, and कारिन् who does, (any act.)

f. (-का)
Granulated sugar.
E.
दृढ firm. गात्र substance, affix कन्.

m. (-न्थिः)
A bambu.
E.
दृढ, and ग्रन्थि a knot.

f. (-ता)
1 Firmness, hardness.
2

Steadiness.
3

Solidity.
4

Strength.
E.
तल् added to दृढ; also with त्व, दृढत्वं.

m. (-कः)
A shark.
E.
दृड hard, दंशक a biter.

m. (-न्वा)
A good archer.
E.
दृढ, and धन्वन् a bow.

mfn. (-धूः-धूः-धु)
Strong, able to bear a weight or load.
E.
दृढ, and धुर् a burthen.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Certain, confirmed, corroborated, undoubted.
E.
दृढ, and निश्चय certainty.

m. (-लः)
The cocoanut.
E.
दृढ hard, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Bound or tied tightly.
E.
दृढ, and वद्ध bound.

f. (-नी)
A creeper, (Echites frutescens.)
E.
दृढ firmly, वन्ध to bind, affixes णिनि, and ङीप्; winding closely round a tree or stem.

mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति)
Faithful, devoted.
E.
दृढ, and भक्ति faith.

f. (-क्तिः)
A faithful mistress or wife.
E.
दृढ fem. form, and भक्ति attachment.

mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि)
Miserly, niggardly, close-fisted,
m. (-ष्टिः)
A sword, any weapon with a hilt or handle.
E.
दृढ firm, and मुष्टि a handle, a fist.

m. (-लः)
The cocoanut.
E.
दृढ hard, and मूल root.

mfn. (-मा-मा-मं)
Having coarse hair on the skin.
m. (-मा)
1 A wild hog.
2 Coarse hair, bristles.
E.
दृढ firm, stiff, and लोमन् the hair of the body.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Observing steadily a religious vow or obligation.
E.
दृढ, and व्रत a vow.

mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि)
1 Strong knit, well fixed or compact, (the person, &c.)
2 Close, compact, free from interstices.
3 Closely connected or allied.
E.
दृढ firm, and सन्धि union, a joint, &c.

f. (-का)
A plant from the fibres of which bow strings are made: see मूर्व्वा.
E.
दृढ firm, and सूत्र a thread, a fibre, affix क.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
Firm in friendship, constant.
E.
दृढ, and सौहृद friendship.

m. (-न्धः)
A plant, a sort of Mimusops: see क्षीरिका.
E.
दृढ firm, and स्कन्ध stem.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Firm-bodied, hard, strong.
n. (-ङ्गं)
A diamond.
E.
दृढ, and अङ्ग body.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
1 The end of a bow.
2 Great pain.
E.
दृढ, and अर्त्ति end of a bow, &c.

m. (-धः)
A hero, one firm in battle.
E.
दृढ, and आयुध war.
